principles: A shape that answers well-formed output while ignoring its input is worse than a missing shape: reuse-before-mint consults it, gets garbage, and the drafter re-mints forever (http_response to 12+ orphan drafts).
Never give an LLM prose goal git-commit authority over an unscoped tree: 'commit drift' sweeps committed 4455 files in 3 commits and truncated live source.
A placement gate that checks directory names but not content lets the same bloat recur one directory down (openspec/changes, leases/, state/, tsc emit).
A closure written as a file ('closed.json … as verified by inspecting') is a claim, not a verification; closure needs a machine check against the edit site.
A supersession declared in a proposal is not a retirement until the old unit is masked and its pinned writers are re-pointed.
Minting born-closed records into the gap store corrupts the close-rate leg of the gap triple; segregate by source before any metric.
A defect noted in passing in a design doc ('worth filing separately') is lost unless it is filed; the scaffold defect has sat unfixed for 52 days.
A producer's last value must go stale loudly: a dead producer serving its final line reads as a fresh measurement.
